[package]
name = "wordfreq"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "Print the 10 most frequent ASCII words read from standard input"

[dependencies]

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build an optimized release binary and place it at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

cargo build --release --locked --quiet
cp target/release/wordfreq app
